reviews.title: Neat Gacha Dungeon Game
reviews.text:
Here’s what it’s got going for it.

-Good turn your brain off kind of game once you get through the rough learning curve. 

-You don’t need to pay to win/pay to have fun and the premium currency (diamonds) you get practically thrown at you for frequent playing. 

-Lots of events in-game to get free cosmetics, power up items, equipment, and even “pets” aka team member NPCs

-Lots of stuff to do in game, quests, dailies, achievements. 

-It’s easy on the eyes with the art style and in-game the control buttons and hotbar are moveable and customizable. D-Pad/Joystick/Tap options, whichever you want. 

Only things to have a heads up for are…

-Has a lot of players from Japan so it must be popular over there but there seems to be an English speaking community too. The online fan wiki in English is outdated but most of the important info is there. 

-Pretty big learning curve, throws a lot at you. If you can get through the beginning levels and push past some of the convoluted (or somewhat oddly translated) info it’s pretty neat and entertaining. 

-UI can be a bit unintuitive at times but I got used to it.

That’s it, this game has thoroughly entertained me in my idle time though.

reviews.title: Clunky UI
reviews.text: I really want to like it.  There aren’t many games like this for mobile.  I am a huge fan of SDV and was looking for something with a similar feel.  This isn’t it for me!  It is waaay too talky!  I hate that I can’t speed up the dialogue.  I cannot, for the life of me, figure out where to save my progress.  Is the beggar cave my house?  How do you craft?  How do you farm?  You can’t seem to decline quests—you automatically accept a new one as soon as you finish one.  None of it is intuitive.  For me, maybe because I haven’t gotten far enough into it, the game is more dungeon crawl/combat heavier than I wanted.  There are some really good open-world, life-sim games for PC on the market but most haven’t translated well to mobile, if the devs even attempted it.  SDV is one of the best examples of how to do it well.  Not sure what the PC version of this game is like but it is not great on mobile though I realize my opinion is contrary to the majority of users.  The screenshots for this game in the app store make this look like something I would love but kind of like the Kairosoft games, it sadly misses the mark.  Maybe I haven’t given it enough of a chance but games that need tutorials are the worst!  If you need to walk me through your game and I still find it hard to navigate, that might be a sign.  I play an inordinate number of similar games and most are pretty intuitive.  I like cute, wholesome, cozy games in which my character doesn’t die and where I can choose the areas of the game to spend more time in.  Also, a good game should grab your interest from the beginning.  Even the app store description makes it sound like you have to work to build up your interest in this game.

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text:
The game is really fun but there are some problems:
1. Lack of music. Music is an important part of any game as it will lead the player how to feel toward certain scenes or places. In elona mobile, there are like 5 ost for all of the game. And there is no combat music when u fight enemies which make it kind of boring
2. The story is too short and very generic.
3. Repetitive gameplay when u reach a certain level. This happen when u reach level 45 and up until lv70 as u will finish the main storyline and u are able to go to north tyris, but you are too weak to beat any north tyris dungeon so u have to go back to farm
4. Marriage with your ally doesnt feel like marriage as the only reation u will get is they blushing, it just feel like you get item from them. Could be better if the game use a cutscene or create a place look like a wedding
5. Cant play offline. I understand they need it to prevent player from cheating time to get reward, but they need to make elona offline otherwise it will be really inconvenience when the player stay in a place that doesnt have wifi
